description: Source code for handling HTTP requests related to button and dialog interactions within a Mattermost plugin flow, including processing user actions, updating flow state, and managing dialog display.

classes.name: Flow
classes.description: Represents a flow managing user interactions, state, and steps within the plugin.

methods.name: handleButtonHTTP
methods.description: HTTP handler for processing button click events from users.

methods.name: handleDialogHTTP
methods.description: HTTP handler for processing dialog submission events from users.

methods.name: handleButton
methods.description: Processes a button click within the flow, returning the associated post.

methods.name: handleDialog
methods.description: Processes a dialog submission within the flow, returning the post, field errors, and error.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Core method to handle button or dialog actions, update state, and determine next steps.

methods.name: processButtonPostActions
methods.description: Processes actions attached to a post, setting URLs for button actions.
